observations: Brown wood-grain small refrigerator standing on top of a white refrigerator.
Blue circular sticker on the upper right of the brown door; text is unreadable.
Keyhole lock visible near the bottom left of the brown door.
Photo 2 shows the door open with an empty beige interior, wire shelves, and door bins.
White refrigerator below has a 'SHARP VISION' badge, but that is a different appliance.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI FABULOUS FURNITURE' appears across all photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show a used appliance with ordinary wear and no obvious heavy soiling.
Photos cannot confirm a pickup location or store.

risks.proof: Video of the unit plugged in and running, with the door opened afterward to show a cold interior.

risks.risk: Door lock or key is missing or broken
risks.proof: Photo of the key fitting the lock or the seller demonstrating the lock.

risks.risk: Interior shelves or door bins are damaged or missing
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full interior showing all removable shelves and bins in place.

proof_requests: Video of the refrigerator running with the door closed, then opened to show it is cold.
Photo of the key for the door lock.
Close-up photo of the blue sticker to read any brand or model text.
response.reason: The item is visibly a small used refrigerator and can be priced at its worst case (not working) without needing a model number.
